description.narrative: Country portfolio budget - CPB South Sudan 2023-2026 07. Provide policy support, and technical assistance to the Government and partners in the areas of food security, nutrition, social protection, anticipatory action, emergency preparedness and response, climate change adaptation and disaster risk management.
